## Best 2kWh portable power station for an RV under $900 (2026)

**My pick is the <Entity category="product" value="BLUETTI AC200L"/>**, especially if you want to connect your RV's 30A shore-power cord directly to the power station.

<row align=start gap={3}>
  <AsyncImage query="BLUETTI AC200L portable power station product white background" aspectRatio="1:1" maxWidth="180px"/>
  <box flex="1" gap={1}>
    <text weight="medium">BLUETTI AC200L</text>
    <title size="xl" color="default">$854.05</title>
    <text color="secondary" size="xs">Listed $899 · With code AFF5OFF</text>
    <badge color="success">Save 5%</badge>
    <text size="sm">2,048Wh battery · 2,400W AC output · LiFePO4 · 30A RV connection</text>
    <text size="xs" color="secondary">Seller: BLUETTI Official US Store</text>
    <text size="sm"><Link url="https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac200l" title="View deal"/></text>
  </box>
</row>

<caption>Deal reported by Dealectric, with prices verified October 27, 2026. The final checkout price may change. <Cite ref="turn946800view0"/></caption>

## How it compares

| Model | Reported price | Capacity | AC output |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **BLUETTI AC200L** | **$854.05 with code** | 2,048Wh | 2,400W |
| BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 | $899 | 2,074Wh | 2,600W |
| Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 | $899 | 2,042Wh | 2,200W |
| ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 | $799 | 1,920Wh | 2,500W |

These prices come from the supplied October 2026 search results, not a live checkout. <Cite ref="turn946800view0"/>

## Why the AC200L wins for RV use

- **RV connection:** Its 30A-style outlet is convenient for connecting a compatible RV shore-power cord.
- **Useful capacity:** About 2kWh is enough for many overnight essentials, including lights, electronics, and a refrigerator, depending on consumption.
- **Strong inverter:** 2,400W continuous output accommodates many small appliances.
- **Expandable battery:** Useful if you eventually want longer off-grid stays.

One important limitation: a 30A RV outlet does **not** mean the station can continuously deliver 30A at 120V. Its 2,400W inverter limits output to approximately 20A at 120V, and running rooftop air conditioning may require more power and capacity.

**Bottom line:** At the reported $854.05 promotional price, the BLUETTI AC200L is my best overall choice for an RV under $900. If you don't need a dedicated RV connection, the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 is also worth considering for its higher output and longer rated battery cycle life.

You can read the <Link url="https://dealectric.com/best-2kwh-power-station-for-rv" title="full RV comparison on Dealectric"/>.
